name: The Legend of Stalvan
summary: In Darkshire, Clerk Daltry searches the town records for Stalvan Mistmantle. The oldest entry points west to the abandoned schoolhouse in Moonbrook, Westfall, where the search for Stalvan’s past begins.

sections.title: The Town Clerk's Request
sections.body: After your inquiries in Darkshire, Clerk Daltry searches the town registry for Stalvan Mistmantle. The ledger has not been updated in years, and it gives Stalvan’s last known home as the schoolhouse in Moonbrook, far to the west. Daltry treats the old address as routine record keeping. He asks you to look into it and bring back any records that might bring Darkshire’s dusty archives up to date.

sections.title: The Ruins of Moonbrook
sections.body: The trail leads from Duskwood into Westfall, where Defias Brotherhood outlaws hold Moonbrook. The town was once a thriving farming settlement. Near its center stands the abandoned schoolhouse, quiet amid the bandit occupation. Inside, an old footlocker holds the first clear clues to Stalvan’s former life as an educator. A restless sorrow also lingers around the chest.

sections.title: A Tragic Haunting
sections.body: Opening the old footlocker summons a Forlorn Spirit, which attacks anyone who uncovers Stalvan’s past. Its mournful magic curses intruders and points to an unresolved tragedy connected to the schoolmaster’s departure from Westfall. The search for old records has become a haunting.

faq.answer: Clerk Daltry keeps the town records in Darkshire Town Hall, in Duskwood. He searches the registry for Stalvan Mistmantle and finds entries that have not been updated in years.
The Moonbrook Schoolhouse is in the center of Moonbrook, in southwestern Westfall. Its architecture resembles Darkshire Town Hall, and Defias bandits surround it.

faq.q: What is inside the Old Footlocker?
faq.answer: The footlocker holds old records and personal belongings from Stalvan Mistmantle’s time as an instructor in Moonbrook. They provide the next lead in the search for his whereabouts.

faq.q: Why does a ghost attack when opening the footlocker?
faq.answer: Opening the footlocker summons a Forlorn Spirit, which attacks with polymorph and curses. The restless spirit is bound to the tragedy surrounding Stalvan’s past and his departure from Moonbrook.
Stalvan was a schoolmaster in Moonbrook before he left to seek private tutoring work elsewhere in the kingdom. His belongings remained locked in the old schoolhouse.
No. The Defias Brotherhood controls Moonbrook, so reaching the schoolhouse means facing armed thieves and outlaws.

angles.text: This part of the search shows how far the kingdom’s rural towns have fractured. You must cross Defias-held Westfall just to follow a Darkshire town registry entry.
The Forlorn Spirit guarding the footlocker uses polymorphism and debilitating curses. You face sorrow-bound magic in an otherwise ordinary classroom.
